definitions.explanation: The act of keeping skin or other surfaces moist. Primarily used in skincare and cosmetics contexts.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{保湿|ほしつ}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
この{保湿|ほしつ}クリームはよく{売|う}れている。
examples.english: This moisturizing cream is selling well.

examples.japanese: {洗顔|せんがん}の{後|あと}にしっかり{保湿|ほしつ}しないと{肌|はだ}が{乾燥|かんそう}してしまう。
examples.english: If you don't moisturize properly after washing your face, your skin will dry out.

notes:
A common term in skincare and beauty product discussions. Almost always refers to keeping skin hydrated rather than general moisture retention.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{保湿|ほしつ}クリーム — moisturizing cream
・{保湿|ほしつ}{成分|せいぶん} — moisturizing ingredients
・{保湿|ほしつ}ケア — moisturizing care
・{保湿|ほしつ}{力|りょく} — moisturizing power
・{保湿|ほしつ}{効果|こうか} — moisturizing effect
